# Sparprofilen: Spännande marknadsskifte under hösten

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts discuss a market rotation that has picked up since US 10-year yields peaked on 8 October. Rate-sensitive sectors such as real estate and consumer discretionary have rallied from depressed valuations, while early-cycle engineering names may be close to their PMI peak. The view on consumers is mixed: household confidence is weak, but some companies are gaining market share. A guest (Ulf) leans towards turnaround 'dogs' such as Electrolux, BHG and Kjell & Co, and is negative on Husqvarna because of its share losses.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 KJELL — Kjell & Co | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Ulf liked the very good report after several quarters and a hard restructuring; finds it interesting even though the stock has already risen.

#### Reasoning

Turnaround after cost restructuring, now showing results over several quarters. If consumer demand recovers, operating leverage could lift earnings sharply. The guest is interested but notes the stock has already moved, so the view is closer to watch than an outright buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the turnaround stalls in coming reports
- if consumer demand weakens again
- if rates rise again

> *"Jag gillade Kjell &amp. Co. Jag tyckte att det kom en jättebra rapport. De har gjort det några kvartal och genomgått ett stålbröd. Det är en sån där som jag tycker är lite intressant."*

---

### 🟠 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

A hated, low-expectation stock that bounces easily when rates fall; Ulf likes such turnaround 'dogs', but Chinese competition is a long-term drag.

#### Reasoning

The stock is up about 30% in weeks as rates fell. A turnaround could bring both a higher P/E and an earnings lift. The upside is mostly a short-term sentiment and rates trade; long-term market position is under pressure from Chinese competition.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates rise again
- if it keeps losing market share to Chinese competitors
- if the consumer recovery fails

> *"Är det något som är så hatat och dissat så krävs det inte så mycket för att aktien ska kunna studsa ordentligt."*

---

### 🟠 BHG — BHG | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Ulf names it among the turnaround 'dogs' that have delivered lately; enormous upside if the turnaround succeeds.

#### Reasoning

Reported against low expectations and the stock rallied with the rates-driven rotation. It is rate-sensitive consumer discretionary with depressed valuation, so a durable fall in rates and a recovering household economy would support the case.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates rise again
- if household consumption weakens

> *"Det är väl liksom B&ampp och G och Electrolux som har levererat nu sista tiden."*

---

### ⛔ HUSQ-B — Husqvarna | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Losing market share in the shift from combustion to electric mowers; exposed to Chinese competition; gloomy consumer commentary in its report.

#### Reasoning

The guest says market share matters more than overall consumption when following consumer companies. Husqvarna is losing share in the electric transition to outside competitors, so a general consumer recovery may not help it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it regains market share in battery/electric products

> *"Husqvarna är ju det här el, alltså när vi går från förbränningsmotorer på gräsklipparna till el och då är de utsatta av en extern konkurrens. Så de tappar ju marknadsandelar."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Double-digit sales growth and market share gains.

#### Reasoning

Market share gains are the key metric for consumer companies, and Clas Ohlson is delivering them with double-digit growth. That supports continued strength, though no explicit buy call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth slows
- if it loses market share

> *"Hittar du rätt med någonting som Clas Ohlson har gjort så tar du marknadsandelar och då blir det ganska bra."*

---

### 🟠 NEWA-B — New Wave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Taking market share, which the guest says works out well in the end.

#### Reasoning

The guest cites New Wave as an example of the market-share thesis: companies that gain share do well even when overall consumption is mixed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market share gains reverse

> *"Tar vi dagens konsumentföretag New Wave så tar man marknadsandelar och då blir det ganska bra till slut."*

---

### 🟡 VOLV-B — Volvo | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Early-cycle engineering may be near a PMI peak. Hosts suggest rotating partly towards other cyclicals while keeping quality large-cap engineering names.

#### Reasoning

Investment super-cycles (energy, infrastructure, defence) remain a structural support. But the hosts ask whether early-cycle names such as Volvo, Sandvik and SKF should be trimmed in favour of rate-sensitive cyclicals. They say quality OMXS30 engineering names still belong in the portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if manufacturing PMI peaks and rolls over
- if rotation into consumer/real estate cyclicals accelerates

> *"ska vi fortsätta äga det som är väldigt tidigt i cykeln? Alltså Volvo, Sandvik, SKF, de bolagen."*

---
